purpose: Stable NFR identities and measurement contracts derived from engineering work-package budget classes without inventing universal numeric thresholds.

policy.binding_rule: Do not invent universal numeric thresholds in the plan. Before implementation can be promoted beyond scaffolded/experimental, each applicable budget class must bind a threshold with unit, percentile/window where relevant, workload, environment, measurement method, owner and exception policy.
policy.production_rule: Production evidence must contain measured values against the bound threshold; target text alone is not evidence.
policy.hard_failure_rule: A bound NFR threshold is non-compensable: aggregate success cannot mask its failure.
